p01.label: Hralgar’s Palace

evidence.quote: DM: We begin mid-morning on a cold and clear November day high in the mountains, the weak sun shining on a ruined giant's palace. We're huddled around the sheltered campfire, warming themselves. It's an elf tending the fire; a halfling cleaning and repairing his arrows; a human resting in meditation, and a pair of dwarves, one heavily armored and tending to a hammer, the other, idly fiddling with a gauntlet some distance from the small camp. A shattered pile of ice marks the spot where only a short while ago, some kind of ice spirit, Ice Maiden, was killed by this group, her heart of solid ice destroyed. From the lower level of this ruined palace ominous clouds of darkness billow out of the tall, giant-sized windows that once cast light and sun into the rooms below. The wind blows harshly, the gusts carrying swirling bits of ice and snow, the shattered remains of the Ice Maiden's heart bringing to you her memories of winters past.

DM: Right. So Hralgar's library, which has the pillar of—the book pillar that describes how to rebuild the engine of of a skieship as well as the small, you know, almost insignificant 4 foot tall notebook of his research on the history of of Vindristjarna.

Seeker: As well as in theory, the phasing stone.

DM: Are in the library, which is the lower ground. There used to be upper stories, but they have vanished in the 1,000 years since the palace was inhabited.

p01.note: The vault note identifies the palace in the Sentinel Range; the current transcript calls the setting high mountains without naming the range. That vault-only orientation is not a transcript-backed parent relation.
